subject: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

Team —

AcuityBio is ready to move the Dedicated/Private walkthrough into a security-panel format so their EU DPO and APAC security lead can attend. We need to propose 3 candidate slots that work across US/EU/APAC and also anticipate DST boundaries (they toggle in June for both EU and parts of US).

Goal: pick a primary slot + 1 backup, confirm internal reviewers, and prepare a 15‑minute pre-call with the infra SME. External attendees: Sam (AcuityBio), Anna (EU DPO / Orbital Health — they’re cross-account reviewer), Kenji (APAC Sec Lead).

Initial constraints I have:
- Marissa: you flagged EU DPO hard stop at 16:00 CET last week — please confirm.
- Soojin: please confirm APAC lead preferred windows (early JST morning vs after 20:00 JST).
- Karthik / Ben: engineering SME availability for the pre-call (30 min).

Candidate windows (local times shown):
A) 2027-06-08 15:00 UTC (US ET 11:00 / CET 17:00 / JST 00:00 next day) — may conflict with EU 17:00 end
B) 2027-06-09 12:00 UTC (US ET 08:00 / CET 14:00 / JST 21:00) — early for US but OK
C) 2027-06-10 06:00 UTC (US ET 02:00 / CET 08:00 / JST 15:00) — APAC-friendly, US early

Please reply with availability or propose alternatives. If none of these are feasible, I'll ask Sam to provide preferred windows and we’ll attempt a round-robin. I attached a timezone matrix for quick reference.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: timezone_matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

Mina —

Quick note: EU DPO (Anna) asked last month for no reviewer calls that finish after 16:00 CET due to end‑of‑day review blocks. That rules out candidate A (17:00 CET end). Candidate B (14:00 CET) is fine for Anna. Candidate C (08:00 CET) works too but she'd prefer afternoon.

Also, if we do the pre-call with the infra SME the business prefers it be the day prior so the SME can prep notes. I can cover the DPO intro if Anna can’t make both sessions.

Marissa
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Mueller <anna.mueller@orbitalhealth.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@meditech.jp>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 07:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

Thanks, Mina and Marissa —

We appreciate the timezone matrix. Our team (AcuityBio) can do candidate B (2027-06-09 12:00 UTC) as primary. Candidate C is acceptable as backup. Candidate A will conflict for Anna as noted.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can the session be recorded? Kenji’s team in APAC may only be able to join asynchronously.
- We’ll need a short agenda: 10min architecture overview, 20min DPO Q&A, 10min APAC-specific controls.
- I attached a very small timezone worksheet with our preferred offsets (I kept local office hours).

Sam
Sam Rhodes
Director, Infrastructure & Compliance
AcuityBio
Attachments: timezone_matrix_acu_v1.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 02:10:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

Mina / team —

If B (2027-06-09 12:00 UTC) is the primary, APAC participation is doable at 21:00 JST (late but acceptable for leads). To reduce churn across DST boundaries, I propose we pick B as primary and schedule a 30-minute pre-call with engineering on 2027-06-08 at 13:00 UTC (09:00 ET / 15:00 CET) — that gives Anna afternoon availability without hitting the 16:00 CET soft-stop.

If Anna’s strictly unavailable for anything before 16:00 CET, we can flip to candidate C and document follow-ups for APAC. Also recommend we record and put key controls in the shared drive ahead of time.

— Soojin
Security & Privacy, Redwood Inference

From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@meditech.jp>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 02:45:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

Hello Mina / Sam —

Thank you for including APAC. I can join candidate B (2027-06-09 21:00 JST) but prefer written evidence and that the session is recorded; joining live beyond 21:30 is difficult for my reviewers. If possible, please limit the live Q&A to 20 min.

Agenda request: please circulate the architecture diagram + list of controls (data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs) at least 48 hours ahead so my team can prepare specific questions.

Kenji Sato
Head of Security — APAC
Meditech Japan

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Rhodes <sam.rhodes@acuitybio.com>, Anna Mueller <anna.mueller@orbitalhealth.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@meditech.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Coord: 3-zone security panel for Dedicated/Private walkthrough — slot options

All —

Thanks for the quick responses. We’ll lock candidate B as primary: 2027-06-09 12:00 UTC (08:00 ET / 14:00 CET / 21:00 JST). Backup will be candidate C (2027-06-10 06:00 UTC).

Action items:
- I will send a calendar invite with a recording option and a link to the shared drive by EOD today.
- Karthik, can you confirm the infra SME for the 30-minute pre-call on 2027-06-08 13:00 UTC?
- Marissa / Anna: we’ll circulate the architecture diagram + controls doc 48 hours before (will aim for 2027-06-07 EOD CET).
- Sam / Kenji: recording will be enabled; live Q&A will be capped at 20 minutes; Kenji—we’ll note the 21:30 JST hard stop.

Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=3zone-panel-confirmed
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/3zone-acu

Attachments: SOW_Q3-Private-Dedicated.pdf, timezone_matrix.xlsx

Please reply with a quick "ack" when you see this so I can send the invites.

Thanks —
Mina
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
